title: Industrial Heavy Machinery Master Lease Agreement
description: Machinery lease featuring a standard 250,000 EUR liability cap in Section 4.1 contradicted by an uncapped gross negligence override in Section 8.4.

payment_terms.quote: Lessee shall satisfy all undisputed lease invoices under payment terms of Net 45 days from receipt.

price_adjustment.quote: Monthly equipment rental rates are firm and fixed for the initial term with no escalation or indexation.

contract_term.quote: The initial duration of this Lease shall endure for a period of 36 months from the effective date.

auto_renewal.quote: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive 12-month periods unless either party delivers written notice of non-renewal.

termination_notice.quote: Lessee may terminate this Agreement without cause upon providing written notice of at least 60 days.

liability_cap.raw: 250,000 EUR in Section 4.1, uncapped for gross negligence in Section 8.4
liability_cap.quote: Notwithstanding Section 4.1 or any other limitation in this Agreement, each party's liability for gross negligence, willful misconduct, and environmental contamination shall be entirely uncapped.

governing_law.quote: This Agreement and any dispute or controversy arising out of it shall be governed by the laws of Switzerland.

volume_commitment.quote: Lessee covenants to maintain a minimum volume commitment of 25 heavy hydraulic excavators per quarter during active operations.
